value: This article serves as a product page for the Valve Index VR Kit, a PC-required virtual reality system priced at $999.00, which includes the game Half-Life: Alyx. While the full kit is currently out of stock and limited to one per customer, the page also details and offers for purchase various replacement components, including left and right controllers ($149.00 each), face gaskets ($39.99), and replacement tethers ($129.00), all with estimated 3-5 day delivery. Additionally, the page provides comprehensive PC system requirements (OS, RAM, GPU, CPU, and USB specifications) necessary for operating the Valve Index system.
